PAGE TITLE: BACK COVER IMAGE
A Moonlit Moonwalk

PHOTOS:
- What the photo shows: NASA astronaut Kate Rubins places a sample marker in the soil before collecting a sample during a nighttime simulated moonwalk in the San Francisco Volcanic Field in Northern Arizona on May 16, 2024. A sample marker provides a photographic reference point for science samples collected on the lunar surface.
- Photo credit: NASA/Josh Valcarcel

KEY FACTS:
- Location: Mary W. Jackson NASA Headquarters, 300 E Street SW (Hidden Figures Way), Washington, DC 20546
